001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.systemlogger;
002
003import java.lang.System.Logger;
004import java.util.Locale;
005import java.util.function.Supplier;
006
007import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
008
009import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
010import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogRouter;
011import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LoggerAPI;
012import io.jstach.rainbowgum.RainbowGum;
013import io.jstach.rainbowgum.spi.RainbowGumServiceProvider;
014
015/**
016 * Abstract System Logger Finder to allow users to create their own custom
017 * System.LoggerFinder. <strong>This implementation does not cache System Loggers</strong>
018 * by name!
019 * <p>
020 * <b>GraalVM native image</b>: this module bundles a {@code native-image.properties} (at
021 * {@code META-INF/native-image/io.jstach.rainbowgum/rainbowgum-systemlogger/}) with
022 * {@code --initialize-at-build-time} for {@code RouterProvider} plus the core classes
023 * ({@code GlobalLogRouter}, {@code StaticLevelResolver}) its {@code LogRouter.global()}
024 * fallback touches on first real use. See {@link #routerProvider} for why this is still
025 * needed even though this class resolves its router lazily rather than eagerly in its
026 * constructor, and why what gets frozen in is just the cheap "nothing bound yet" state,
027 * not anything environment-specific. native-image's own embedded configuration discovery
028 * picks this up from this module's jar automatically, no extra plugin or flag needed on
029 * the consuming side.
030 *
031 * @see #INITIALIZE_RAINBOW_GUM_PROPERTY
032 */
033public abstract class RainbowGumSystemLoggerFinder extends System.LoggerFinder {
034
035        /**
036         * Initialization flag.
037         * @see InitOption
038         */
039        public static final String INITIALIZE_RAINBOW_GUM_PROPERTY = LogProperties.ROOT_PREFIX + "systemlogger.initialize";
040
041        private final Supplier<? extends InitOption> optSupplier;
042
043        /*
044         * Resolved lazily, on the first getLogger(...) call, not eagerly in the constructor.
045         * Constructing a System.LoggerFinder happens through java.util.ServiceLoader, which
046         * the JDK itself may trigger from all sorts of incidental static initialization (see
047         * rainbowgum-jdk's own module javadoc); under GraalVM native-image's default
048         * build-time class initialization in particular, an eager constructor here would
049         * freeze whatever InitOption/RainbowGum state happened to resolve during the build
050         * into the image, using build-time system properties and a build-time
051         * RainbowGum.getOrNull() check, not the real ones the running image would see. A
052         * benign race (two threads computing the same idempotent value once each) is fine
053         * here, matching InitRouterProvider's own existing lazy resolution of its RainbowGum
054         * supplier just below.
055         *
056         * This alone does not make a custom System.LoggerFinder fully invisible to
057         * native-image's build-time analysis, since the JDK's own internals call
058         * System.getLogger(...) incidentally, for their own diagnostics, from all sorts of
059         * unrelated code paths that end up reachable during a real build (observed triggers:
060         * java.time/java.util.Locale formatting, and separately
061         * com.oracle.svm.core.jdk.TrustStoreManagerFeature loading the default trust store at
062         * build time); whichever registered LoggerFinder is on the classpath gets swept up
063         * regardless of how lazy its own construction is. What laziness here does buy: since
064         * getLogger(...) only ever runs this exact code path for real, what gets resolved and
065         * frozen into the image heap as a side effect is always the correct, fresh answer:
066         * when RainbowGumServiceProvider.RainbowGumEagerLoad exists (SLF4J's own facade
067         * implements it), that answer is just LogRouter.global()'s ambient, not-yet-bound
068         * queuing router, the same "nothing bound yet" state any freshly started JVM begins
069         * in, not anything environment-specific baked in from the build. That still pulls in
070         * a handful of core classes (GlobalLogRouter, StaticLevelResolver) that also need
071         * flagging, confirmed by hand against a real GraalVM build; see this module's own
072         * bundled native-image.properties for the exact list, and rainbowgum-jdk's own
073         * SystemLoggingFactory javadoc for the companion flags reached via
074         * LogProperties.findGlobalProperties() instead. Not every class in the whole
075         * io.jstach.rainbowgum package needs this treatment, only these specific ones.
076         */
077        private volatile @Nullable RouterProvider routerProvider;
078
079        /**
080         * Values (case is ignored) for {@value #INITIALIZE_RAINBOW_GUM_PROPERTY}.
081         */
082        public enum InitOption {
083
084                /**
085                 * Will not initialize rainbow gum.
086                 */
087                FALSE,
088                /**
089                 * Will initialize rainbow gum.
090                 */
091                TRUE,
092                /**
093                 * (default) Will check if there are implementations of
094                 * {@link RainbowGumServiceProvider.RainbowGumEagerLoad} and if there are not will
095                 * load rainbow gum.
096                 */
097                CHECK,
098                /**
099                 * Will reuse an existing rainbow gum or fail.
100                 */
101                REUSE;
102
103                /**
104                 * Parses an init option from a property value.
105                 * @param input from properties.
106                 * @return init option.
107                 */
108                public static InitOption parse(String input) {
109                        if (input.isBlank())
110                                return FALSE;
111                        return InitOption.valueOf(input.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT));
112                }
113
114        }
115
116        /**
117         * Creates the logger inder based on init option.
118         * @param optSupplier can be resolved with {@link #initOption(LogProperties)}.
119         */
120        protected RainbowGumSystemLoggerFinder(Supplier<? extends InitOption> optSupplier) {
121                this.optSupplier = optSupplier;
122        }
123
124        private RouterProvider routerProvider() {
125                var rp = this.routerProvider;
126                if (rp != null) {
127                        return rp;
128                }
129                try {
130                        var opt = optSupplier.get();
131                        rp = switch (opt) {
132                                case FALSE -> n -> LogRouter.global();
133                                case TRUE -> new InitRouterProvider(RainbowGum::of);
134                                case CHECK -> {
135                                        if (RainbowGumServiceProvider.RainbowGumEagerLoad.exists()) {
136                                                yield n -> LogRouter.global();
137                                        }
138                                        yield new InitRouterProvider(RainbowGum::of);
139                                }
140                                case REUSE -> new InitRouterProvider(() -> {
141                                        var gum = RainbowGum.getOrNull();
142                                        if (gum == null) {
143                                                throw new IllegalStateException(
144                                                                "SystemLogging was configured to reuse a loaded Rainbow Gum but none was found. "
145                                                                                + INITIALIZE_RAINBOW_GUM_PROPERTY + "=" + opt);
146                                        }
147                                        return gum;
148                                });
149                        };
150                        this.routerProvider = rp;
151                        return rp;
152                }
153                catch (Exception e) {
154                        // We have to do this because it because very difficult
155                        // to determine why the System Logging fails as it does not even print the
156                        // exception.
157                        var gum = RainbowGum.getOrNull();
158                        if (gum != null) {
159                                gum.config().alerts().error(getClass(), "Failed to create System.LoggerFinder", e);
160                        }
161                        else {
162                                System.err.println("[ERROR] - RAINBOW_GUM Failed to create System.LoggerFinder");
163                                e.printStackTrace();
164                        }
165                        throw e;
166                }
167        }
168
169        @Override
170        public Logger getLogger(String name, Module module) {
171                var router = routerProvider().router(name);
172                if (!router.isChangeable(name)) {
173                        var level = router.levelResolver().resolveLevel(name);
174                        return LevelSystemLogger.of(name, level, router.route(name, level));
175                }
176                return RainbowGumSystemLogger.of(name, router);
177        }
178
179        /**
180         * Gets the init option from properties.
181         * @param properties usually system properties.
182         * @return initialization option.
183         */
184        protected static InitOption initOption(LogProperties properties) {
185                return properties.forKey(INITIALIZE_RAINBOW_GUM_PROPERTY)
186                        .ofString()
187                        .map(InitOption::parse)
188                        .or(InitOption.CHECK)
189                        .validateNow(RainbowGumSystemLoggerFinder.class);
190        }
191
192        private interface RouterProvider {
193
194                LogRouter.RootRouter router(String loggerName);
195
196        }
197
198        private static class InitRouterProvider implements RouterProvider {
199
200                private final Supplier<RainbowGum> supplier;
201
202                private volatile @Nullable RainbowGum gum = null;
203
204                InitRouterProvider(Supplier<RainbowGum> supplier) {
205                        super();
206                        this.supplier = supplier;
207                }
208
209                @Override
210                public LogRouter.RootRouter router(String loggerName) {
211                        LogRouter.RootRouter router;
212                        RainbowGum gum = this.gum;
213                        if (gum == null) {
214                                gum = this.gum = supplier.get();
215                        }
216                        gum.config().loggerRegistry().registerLoggerName(LoggerAPI.Standard.SYSTEM_LOGGER, loggerName);
217                        if (gum.config().changePublisher().isEnabled(loggerName)) {
218                                router = LogRouter.global();
219                        }
220                        else {
221                                router = gum.router();
222                        }
223                        return router;
224                }
225
226        }
227
228}
